name: Ooms Polymer Modified Bitumen Pvt. Ltd.
d:
India is not short of roads.
It is short of roads that last.

Across the country, infrastructure is being rebuilt faster than it is being rethought. Repeated overlays, rising road levels, poor drainage integration, and overdependence on virgin materials are creating a cycle of escalating cost and declining performance.

The challenge is no longer construction.
The challenge is longevity, performance, and sustainability.

Ooms India operates at this intersection.

Ooms Polymer Modified Bitumen Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturer of value-added bituminous products, supporting road and runway infrastructure across India. With a legacy rooted in global expertise and over two decades of presence in India, the organization brings together advanced material technology, in-house R&D, and on-ground execution support.

But the focus goes beyond supply.

Ooms works as a performance partner across the lifecycle of infrastructure—enabling better outcomes through:

Advanced modified binders (PMB, CRMB, Performance Grade systems)
Bitumen emulsions and specialty products
Rejuvenation technologies such as REJUBIT for recycled pavements
Technical support including mix design, testing, and on-site assistance

Backed by NABL-accredited laboratories, multi-location manufacturing facilities, and a strong technical team, Ooms combines material science with real-world application.

The approach is simple:
Build roads that perform, not just roads that get built.

As the industry moves toward recycling, sustainability, and performance-driven specifications, the need is not just for better materials—but for better systems.

Ooms continues to work closely with industry stakeholders, research institutions, and project partners to enable this shift—towards infrastructure that is more durable, more efficient, and more responsible.

name: Saxo Bank
d:
At Saxo we believe that when you invest, you unlock a new curiosity for the world around you. 

Discovering an intuitive desire within to actively learn, explore, and ask questions, you will engage with new companies, new communities, maybe even new countries. You could call this an appetite or passion for new knowledge and skills. We call it curiosity. Ultimately everything we do as a company is focused on getting curious people invested in the world by giving our clients more ways to make more of their money.  

We began in Copenhagen, Denmark in 1992 with a clear vision: to make the global financial markets accessible for more people. In 1998, we launched one of the first online trading platforms in Europe, providing professional-grade tools and easy access to global financial markets for anyone who wanted to invest. 

Today we are a well-capitalised Danish (EU) bank with top capital ratios and positive rating from S&P, trusted by over 850,000 clients. As an international award-winning investment firm for investors and traders who are serious about investing, our clients enjoy regulated and reliable access to over 70,000 financial instruments on our industry-leading platforms. Keeping our headquarters in our beloved Denmark, we have expanded our reach to having more than 72 nationalities employed in offices in 15 countries. 

We are proud of our Scandinavian heritage and we are committed to the values of trust, fairness, and security. We believe this gives our clients the confidence to be adventurous and curious. 
Curiosity can lead you to places you never could have imagined. When you invest, you stimulate the mind, you see new perspectives, and you broaden your horizons. Personal transformation is inevitable as you develop a sincere interest and curiosity for not only the world, but also for others. 

At Saxo our greatest hope is for everyone to become engaged, to feel empowered, and to Be Invested.

name: AGRIM
d:
We are an asset-light agri-inputs e-commerce platform for retailers

The $50 billion+ agri-inputs industry faces challenges from a diversified, fragmented, and seasonal demand. Traditional supply chains are costly and lack data visibility, leading to inventory losses or unmet demand. Our on-demand tech platform solves these issues by reducing demand and supply mismatches.

We have recently raised $20.5m Series B funds from Asia Impact and BII to strengthen our technology, enhance offerings, and expand operations.

*Problem Statement*
In India, we have a lot of different crops, but our farmers don't have much land. This makes it tough for them to get the right farming supplies at the right time. The brick-and-mortar supply chain has problems like having limited products, too much inventory in stock and working capital, high returns and not being able to give farmers what they need when they need it.

Over 40,000 MSME agri-inputs manufactures rely on this data dark supply chain, but it hurts their profits.

*What's Agrim doing?*
In a perfect world, we would take products from the manufacturers and deliver them directly to the farmers, like how Swiggy and Zomato deliver food.

But it's too expensive to do that for farmers. Plus, farmers also need advice on farming, which requires local knowledge. So, we're creating a platform for local shops that farmers trust. We're making a system where these stores can get the farming supplies they need just-in-time.

We offer a big selection of 1,00,000+ products to these stores, which is way better than other options.

We use technology to keep our costs low, stay asset-light, and make sure we can reach every part of the country. We're focused on making things better bit by bit and letting compounding do the magic.

name: Intugine - Logistics through Innovation
d:
Intugine is India's enterprise supply chain intelligence platform — helping logistics-heavy manufacturers, shippers, and E-commerce and Quick commerce enterprises move from basic visibility to operational intelligence.

What we build:

IntuTrack 2.0 — Real-time multimodal fleet visibility combining GPS, SIM, FASTag, and activity sensing using sensors. Covers FTL, PTL, container, and bulk freight across road, rail, and port.

Cruise™ — An AI Control Tower that autonomously manages logistics exceptions. Cruise detects SLA breach risks 4–6 hours early, classifies halt events, and deploys AI agents Vedika and Ved to resolve exceptions in 8 regional Indian languages — achieving 85%+ autonomous resolution and 70% reduction in control room headcount.

IntuGenie — An AI-powered transportation analytics layer that turns existing visibility data into customised operational intelligence. Different supply chains get different intelligence — cement teams get unloading verification and route compliance analytics; coal and power teams get halt classification and plant inbound ETA management; freight marketplaces get transporter reliability scoring and supply intelligence.

IAS (Intugine Activity Sensing) — IoT-based activity sensing using sensors that detects cargo-level events GPS cannot verify — unloading confirmation, pilferage detection, and back-unloading risk for bulk freight in cement, coal, steel, and mining.

Today, Intugine works with 100+ global enterprise names including Adani Cements, Hindalco, UltraTech Cement, Flipkart, Mahindra Logistics, Gati and Diageo,.

d:
Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) is one of the world’s largest travel companies, employing 12,000 like-minded individuals – known as ‘Flighties’. 

Our story dates to 1973, when founder Graham Turner (aka “Skroo") and friend Geoff “Spy” Lomas buy a double-decker bus and take off on their first tour around Spain, Portugal and Morrocco, 3 years later forming the first business, Top Deck. After flight deregulations in the 80s our first retail "Flight Centre" stores opened in Australia in 1982, London in 1984, and NZ in 1987. 

1987 was also the year we held our first “Global Gathering” awards event celebrating our amazing people, a tradition that continues to this day. 

And in 2025 we launched our very first loyalty program, World360 Rewards! Our Australian customers now able to earn and redeem points across Flight Centre, Travel Associates, and Cruiseabout.

We’re in our 40s now and a lot has changed! With global headquarters in Brisbane, Australia, our company owned leisure and corporate travel businesses span three major regions: APAC, The Americas and EMEA. 

Our flagship corporate travel management brand, FCM, extends our reach even further through a network covering over 100 countries via both company-owned operations and independent licensees. 

With 30 brands across our global footprint, our team spans from customer-facing to internal support roles. The opportunities just as diverse – from a Travel Consultant at Flight Centre or Envoyage, to a Machine Learning Scientist in one of our tech pillars. 

Together, we live and breathe our number one philosophy, Our People, driven by our purpose ‘To open up the world for those who want to see’.  

Our values are simple and powerful - Ownership, Egalitarianism and Irreverence.  

We support our people with opportunities to help you thrive, connect, give, move and be rewarded. Our people have access to a suite of curated benefits to ensure holistic wellbeing – from mental and physical health to financial freedom.

They say home is where the heart is. Which is why, since 1942, we’ve been helping customers transform empty properties to homes by dressing them up in warm hues, pastel shades and cool colours, to create spaces that truly represent you.
Asian Paints has a lot of identities. We have been India’s largest paint company for almost 50 years and are part of the top 10 decorative paint companies worldwide. We have operations in 14 countries, and manufacturing facilities in 27 global locations. Having subsidiaries in India and abroad, Asian Paints encompasses the best of Indian and global traits, homegrown and international qualities. Our subsidiaries are Berger International, Scib, Taubman, Apco, Ess Ess. We have joint ventures with PPG in automotive and industrial paints and Sleek International Modular Kitchens. 
With different strokes for all types of folks, we have paints ranging from luxury enamels to economic quality distemper in all shades imaginable.
Despite our phenomenal growth in the paint segment, we didn’t just stop there. We expanded with our wallpaper range - Nilaya, wall stencils, wood finishes, adhesives and waterproofing solutions. We listened to our customers when they asked for hassle-free painting services and now provide end-to-end servicing in multiple cities. We constantly innovate with service offerings – from colour consultancy at home, online consultancy services, to providing inspiration centres through Colour stores.
Our reputation often precedes us but we have never let that be our resting laurel. We constantly strive to push boundaries – not only by creating more sustainable ways of carrying out extensive community initiatives that touch the lives of people, but also through our operations. Our people are passionate, innovative and work with integrity. Our actions reflect these values and our businesses across the globe ensure they maintain the quality of work and standards of excellence we are known for.

Our commitment to excellence extends to our people, earning us recognition as one of India’s ‘Top 10 Best Companies to Work For’ for four consecutive years (2010-2013). In 2016, we were named the Best E-commerce Company by the Great Place to Work Institute.

* *IEPF & Unclaimed Shares Assistance* — Guidance on applicable eligibility requirements, documentation, and procedures for eligible share and dividend claims.

* *Mutual Funds & Investment Solutions* — Exploring investment options, their objectives, suitability, and associated risks.

* *Insurance & Health Insurance* — Understanding coverage options and protection needs.

* *Retirement Planning & Risk Management* — Preparing for future financial requirements and evaluating financial risks.

*Our Approach*

We value clear communication, responsible financial awareness, and a client-focused approach. We believe that understanding the available options, relevant risks, and applicable processes is an important part of making financial decisions.

Follow Sanguine Capital for financial insights, educational content, service updates, and perspectives on wealth management and investment-related topics.

name: FCI CCM
d:
FCI CCM is a financial technology company helping banks modernize how they communicate with customers in a real-time, digital-first world.

For many financial institutions, customer communication still operates on fragmented systems across alerts, statements, campaigns, and servicing updates. This often leads to disconnected experiences, operational complexity, and missed opportunities for meaningful engagement.

FCI CCM addresses this challenge through the VARTA Suite, an intelligence-driven platform designed specifically for banks and financial institutions.

The platform enables organizations to move beyond high-volume messaging toward insight-led communication, where every interaction is informed by customer behavior, context, and real-time signals.

The VARTA Suite brings together four core capabilities within a unified architecture:
• 𝐕𝐀𝐑𝐓𝐀𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐞 – A centralized communications platform for managing templates, governing document creation, and orchestrating consistent communication across digital and traditional channels.
• 𝐕𝐀𝐑𝐓𝐀𝐒𝐢𝐠𝐧𝐚𝐥 – A real-time notification engine that powers mission-critical alerts such as OTPs, transaction notifications, fraud alerts, and servicing updates with high delivery reliability.
• 𝐕𝐀𝐑𝐓𝐀𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦 – An enterprise communication processing layer designed for high-volume statement generation, reporting, and secure document distribution for banks and large enterprises.
• 𝐕𝐀𝐑𝐓𝐀𝐒𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐞 – An AI-driven intelligence layer that analyzes behavioral signals and contextual data to trigger personalized engagement and recommend next-best actions.

Together, these capabilities help banks shift from static messaging systems to intelligent, moment-driven engagement, improving operational efficiency while delivering more relevant customer experiences.

With ACME Solar, we are lighting up homes and industrial units in India. We have built a solar portfolio of over 6 GWp with over 1.5 GWp of capacity currently in operation and another 10 GWp under construction. The projects are spread across 13 states in India and Oman.
Through ACME GHC, we are set to replicate the success of our Bikaner Pilot Project for Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia. After demonstrating our capabilities and credible experience at Bikaner, we are developing commercial-scale green fuel projects integrating multiple technologies across the Globe. 
With ACME Superfood, we have introduced Mycoprotein, a fermentation-derived, vegan, edible, fungi-based protein superfood with an excellent nutritional profile.
Our vision is clear: to ascend as a top global green energy provider by 2030. We’re collaborating with governments, partners, and visionaries across the globe to develop clean energy projects in diverse locales.
As catalysts for change, we’re committed to supporting new ventures that share our vision for a cleaner, greener planet. Join the ACME movement, where every step we take is a leap toward innovation, sustainability, and a luminous future.
Let’s build a brighter, more sustainable future together.

It includes:
- KaneAI: An AI-native testing agent that plans, authors, and evolves end-to-end tests in plain English across web and mobile.
- Kane CLI: A terminal-native command-line testing agent that verifies what you or coding agents built against requirements in a real browser.
- Agent Testing: Test chatbots, voice assistants, video agents, image analyzer agents, and phone caller agents for hallucinations, bias, and toxicity.
- Agent Assurance: Agentic testing for autonomous AI agents. It reads the agent's code, generates scenarios, and verifies actions through API and database checks.
- Real Device Cloud: Manual and automated testing across 10,000+ real Android and iOS devices.
- HyperExecute: An AI-native test orchestration platform that runs tests up to 70% faster than traditional cloud grids.
- Automation Cloud: Run Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, and Appium tests in parallel on 3,000+ browser-OS combinations and real devices.
- SmartUI: AI-native visual regression testing that captures and compares screenshots across browsers, devices, and resolutions, flagging real changes, not noise.
- Accessibility Testing: Identify and resolve WCAG and ADA issues across websites, web apps, and mobile apps.
- Browser Cloud: Browser infrastructure for AI agents: real Chrome sessions on demand for Claude, Cursor, and Gemini.
- Test Management: AI-native test management for manual and automated tests with two-way Jira sync.

Use 120+ integrations like Jira, GitHub, and Slack to accelerate testing across the entire software development lifecycle.

name: Nestlé
d:
As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.
